name: TrueNAS
description: Shows a TrueNAS (Community Edition 25.04 or newer) as a host with its containers, virtual machines and apps as guests, matched to your network devices by IP or MAC. Read-only, with an API key over TLS. Tested on TrueNAS 25.10.6 (VMs with simulated data).
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Containers, VMs and apps of a TrueNAS as guests of the NAS.
